body.p: The witch and the Enets woman lived in the same camp. One lives in her own tent, the other one lives in her own tent. The witch and her friend lived in the same camp. One of them has her own tent, the other [ShA:] The sentence is not finished.oneâ¦ The Enets woman had two daughters. Once the witch said to the Enets woman: "Let's pick some grass, let's go pick grass for ourselves." "Let's go." They went and were picking grass for themselves. âEnets woman, â (the witch) said, â let me look for lice in your head!â. While they were picking the grass. She poked the Enets woman in the ear with an awl. While she was looking for lice, she poked her ear. So she killed her friend, after all. She wrapped her in the grass. And her hair was dangling, after all, at that time people, well, braided their heads. Oh, and then the witch wrapped her friend into the grass and carried her to her tent. She carries her into her tent, oh, and the girls said. âOh, that witch must have killed our mother, â the older girl said, â only her hair is in the grass.â. Well. The witch took her friend to her tent, and then she probably ate her, maybe she boiled her or did something else to her. Then the childrenâ¦[ShA:] The sentence is not finished. The elder girl said: "Let's run away while the witch is sleeping." The witch fell asleep. Having filled the boots with the moss, they laid them across the bed, covered them with a parka, as if they were sleeping. Oh, they took their mother's thimble, their mother's comb, their mother's scythe. After a while the witch woke up and did not â¦ these children. âHa ha, fuck you, Iâll catch up with you anyway!â. Well, the witch is heard, she ran after the children. "Oh, â the elder said, â the witch there appeared, now she will â¦ us." She threw her mother's scythe. A huge iron ridge has grown between them. While trampling along this iron ridge, the witch broke all her nails. Here the girls broke away from her. Oh, and the witch climbed after a while, no matter [ShA:] PÉju is not clear here.how painfully she climbed. She saw them again. This girl saw her, the older girl saw her and said: âThe giantess is coming again.â. They threw their mother's comb. So, a large snowy forest grew between them. While she was in this forest, apparently a witch was wandering in this forest. The children broke away from her again. After a while, the witch appeared from the forest. Having finished her sufferings. Oh, after a while the girl said: "That terrible one is here again." They threw their mother's thimble. They threw their mother's thimble, this thimble became, well, an iron hill. Climbing this iron hill, the witch probably broke her nails again, but with difficulty she climbed anyway. Oh, after a while the girls saw a river in front. They saw the river, oh, there is an old woman sitting on the other side. "Granny, take us to the other side, the witch is catching up with us." "Of course, I will take you, but how is my head?" "Your head, â she said, â is like ripe grass, it is white". "How is my face?" "Your face is like the sun that just came out." "Hey, take your mates!" She said to her son. "Let your back be wide, do not drop your mates into the water." That guy took these girls. After a while, the giantess appeared, the witch: "Hey, take me across!". The witch said. Oh, the old woman said, "â¦, how is my head?" âYour head, â she said, â is like tangled branches of a tree.â. "And how is my face?" "Your face. Your face, â she said, â is like, well, a place from where a stone was taken out". Aha, she said to her son: "Take her! Let your back be narrow!" She said to her son: "Let your back be narrow!" After a whileâ¦ the guy and the witch drowned under the water. They drowned under the water, and they have been under the water for a long time. After a while, the guy appeared all covered with blood. It turns out he was fighting a witch underwater. Well, they live this way for some time. After some time, the old woman and the old man said to these girls: âOur life is over, and now you go to live, look for it. Grandfather will now give you a boat. Stop there, on the cape of the island, you will find a sled there". And they took â¦. âYou will see many different things at this glade, but do not touch anything, do not take anything from there.â. At some point these girls left. (â¦). So they walked along the glade. So they walked along the glade. They saw various things. For gamesâ¦ Yes, the younger one said: âHey, sister, get me a toy.â. Leave, why do you need it, why do I need it, the granny said: "Don't touch anything here." As long as they go, there are various things. Oh, the other girl keeps saying: "Get me a toy." "No." The grandmother said: "Do not take anything from there." While they were walking, another one, the little girl grabbed a drill. Yeah, she grabbed a drill. After she took that drill, her eye popped out. Her eye popped out, and she died. (â¦). She died. She said: "Where should I put my sister?" When she finished crying again, she said: "Where would I bury my sister?" The elder one said: "Where should I better bury my late sister? It seems to be good to bury at the edge of the forest". Oh, this dead girl cried. Where will I bury you? "It seems good to bury you at the tip of the island." She started crying again. They go again: âIf I bury you on the hill, it will probably be fine?â. This girl started crying again. Some time later. She said: "I'll bury you in a bear's den." The other girl became silent. So she left her sister in a bear's den. The girl left. After a while, the girl, while walking, got tired. She was tired and found a stump. She stepped on the stump. The stump broke. The stump is broken, and a scary witch is visible from the footing of the stump. "Ho-ho, where are you going, let's go together." "Well, let's go". The little one goes with the witch. After a while, the two men appeared near the sledge. These were the people who stored the wood. They stored the wood. One has a white seat and white reindeer, and the other has a black seat and black reindeer. Oh, the witch got on the sledge to the one who had a white seat and white reindeer. And the girl sat on the sledge to the one who had black reindeer. After some time, the people who stored the wood get to their place. Well, the witch said to that one. (â¦). (â¦). Another one said: "I'm telling you, the one that sat on your sledge doesn't seem to be a human, she seems to be a witch." I always tell you: âWhy these white reindeer, why the white seat?â. Well. However it were, that black man said to the Enets girl: "Well, let's go home." And the witch went with the man who had white reindeer, and drove fast, they got home. So they got home. (â¦). And after they lived for two years or for some time. The one who had white reindeer took the witch as his wife. And, well, the black one took the Enets girl as his wife. They live for two years, and after a while the father, the old man, said: âOur daughters-in-law will probably go to visit, they probably have some relatives.â. Oh, the girl says: âDo I have someone, I donât have anyone. Iâll probably go just to see the bones of my relatives, the bones of my dead relatives." Well, and as for the witch, she got active and said: "I'll go for a visit." Anyway, the black guy and his wife left. He went with his wife. And earlier, the girl buried her sister in a bear's den. Oh, they stopped near that den. Two small bears, two small bears got out of the den. After some time, the little sister she had buried long ago came out of that den. She said to the children, to these bears, to the bears: "Don't frighten your grandmother, don't frighten your grandmother." After some time, probably they entered the house or did something else. This same girl, the girl whose eye popped out, who was in the bear's den, said: "Now our grandfather will come, do not be afraid of him." After a while, a real big bear came. A big bear came. The girl said, the girl who lived in the bear's den. She said: âWhat will our guests take away, what will our guests take away?â. âFor the guests, â he said, the big bear said, â I have already prepared gifts for the guests.â. In the morning, they left. Of course, they stayed for the night. In the morning the girl went outside. The big bear brought two tied sledges. He harnessed two bears to these two tied sledges.[ShA:] The syntax is apparently unexpected. Finally, they will go home. The younger girl said: "When you get home, when you get home, having kissed, send these bears back." After a while they arrived home, the old woman went outside, the old woman and the old man went outside. At some point. Behind their sledge, the bears. Are harnessed, two tied sledges are harnessed with bears. That black guy released these bears, having kissed. They went the way they had come. After a while the witch arrived. Well, with her husband. She arrived with her husband. They brought only mice. (â¦). They brought only mice, but according to her, these are reindeer. The old man said, oh, and killed all these mice. Well, the witch said: "My former reindeer, at least I could eat their tendon skins."
